dt2.14:65.5: Samucchedenupalabbhati mogha-pucchakena vā ti. Vippayuttena saṃgahīta-asaṃgahīta-pada-niddeso. Dhātukathāppakaranaṃ samattaṃ Mahāvihāra-vāsinaṃ vācanā-maggena. Saṃgahamasaṃgahaṃ sampayoga-vippayogaṃ paramhi ca Gambhīraṃ
dt2.14:65.6: nipuṇaṃ ṭhānaṃ tam pi Buddhena desitaṃ.
